newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan jet fuel fire death toll rises to 10.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan jet fuel fire death toll rises to 10.

text.p: Three more people have died of burns after a Pakistan Air Force (PAF) plane dumped fuel tanks over Karachi, bringing the death toll to 10, doctors said on Saturday.
Seven people had died earlier and six were injured in a fire that was caused after the pilot of a French-built Mirage fighter jettisoned its fuel tanks over a residential area on Thursday.
Three of the injured people, including a six-year-old girl, died on Friday night, the doctors said.
The PAF says the pilot dropped the fuel tanks after the plane developed engine trouble on a routine training flight. The plane later landed safely at a PAF base in Karachi.
